nodes.label: STTN: Spatial-Temporal Transformer Networks for Video Inpainting
nodes.author: Y. Zeng, J. Fu, H. Chao
nodes.rationale: Formulates video inpainting as multi-to-multi: fill holes in all input frames simultaneously using multi-scale patch-based multi-head attention (frame-level encoder -> stacked spatial-temporal transformers -> frame-level decoder) plus a spatial-temporal adversarial loss; motivated by prior attention methods assuming global affine motion and lacking temporal-coherence optimization; beats SOTA by 2.4% PSNR / 19.7% VFID.
